_readme: Scope profile: a typical 30 mm hunting scope with a side parallax knob. A starting point for a new profile: copy this folder, rename it and measure. All lengths in mm. 'Left' and 'right' as seen by the shooter: windage on the right, parallax / illumination knob (if any) on the left. Any key from params.json can be added here to override it for this scope.

scope._note: GUESSED dimensions, not a real scope.
scope._TUBE_DIAMETER: Main tube either side of the turret housing (25.4 for a 1 inch tube)
scope._SADDLE_LENGTH: Turret housing (the block the turrets sit on) along the tube
scope._SADDLE_WIDTH: Turret housing left to right, not counting the turrets
scope._SADDLE_HEIGHT: Turret housing top to bottom, not counting the elevation turret
scope._SADDLE_DROP: How far the bottom of the turret housing hangs below the bottom of the tube (0 if flush)
scope._ELEVATION_DIAMETER: Elevation turret (or its cap), widest point
scope._ELEVATION_HEIGHT: Bottom of the tube to the top of the elevation turret / cap
scope._WINDAGE_WIDTH: Left side of the tube to the end of the windage turret / cap
scope._LEFT_KNOB_DIAMETER: Parallax / illumination knob on the left. 0 if the scope has none
scope._LEFT_KNOB_WIDTH: Right side of the tube to the end of the left knob
scope._RING_GAP: Clear space between the scope rings along the tube. The lock has to fit between them; 0 skips the check
scope._RECEIVER_GAP: Bottom of the tube to whatever is under it at the turret housing (receiver, rail). The hood and plate must fit under there; 0 skips the check
